desc:
A day lasts from time 0 to eventTime. Meeting i occupies the half-open range [startTime[i], endTime[i]). The meetings are given in increasing order, never overlap, and may touch.

You may pick at most one meeting and move it to any other position in the day: it keeps its duration, must stay inside [0, eventTime] and must not overlap any other meeting. (It may jump over other meetings, so the order can change.) Return the maximum possible length of a continuous stretch of time without any meeting.

eventTime = 10, startTime = [0, 7, 9], endTime = [1, 8, 10]  ->  7

Move [0, 1) into the gap between times 8 and 9; the free stretch [0, 7) appears.
constraints: 0 ≤ startTime[i] < endTime[i] ≤ startTime[i+1] (for consecutive meetings), and endTime[n-1] ≤ eventTime
hints: List the n + 1 free gaps. Moving meeting i merges the two gaps on its sides.

After the merge, the meeting must go somewhere. If it fits into one of the other gaps, the merged stretch keeps its full size plus the meeting's length; if not, push the meeting to one end of the merged region and you still keep both gaps' total.
For meeting i you need the largest gap among all gaps except the two adjacent ones. Prefix and suffix maxima over the gap array give it in O(1).
editorial: Let gap[0..n] be the free gaps; meeting i sits between gap[i] and gap[i+1] and has length d. If it is removed from its place, a free stretch of gap[i] + d + gap[i+1] appears, but the meeting must be put back somewhere. If some other gap (not i or i+1) has size at least d, put it there: the stretch stays at gap[i] + d + gap[i+1]. Otherwise slide it to the left or right end of that region, leaving gap[i] + gap[i+1].

Every original gap touches some meeting, so considering every meeting as the one to move also covers the option of not moving anything useful. Compute prefix maxima pre and suffix maxima suf of the gaps; the best other gap for meeting i is max(pre[i], suf[i+2]). Take the best candidate over all i. Time O(n), space O(n).
solution:
def maxFreeAfterMovingOne(eventTime, startTime, endTime):
    n = len(startTime)
    gaps = []
    prev = 0
    for s, e in zip(startTime, endTime):
        gaps.append(s - prev)
        prev = e
    gaps.append(eventTime - prev)
    pre = [0] * (n + 2)
    for i in range(n + 1):
        pre[i + 1] = max(pre[i], gaps[i])
    suf = [0] * (n + 3)
    for i in range(n, -1, -1):
        suf[i] = max(suf[i + 1], gaps[i])
    best = 0
    for i in range(n):
        d = endTime[i] - startTime[i]
        merged = gaps[i] + gaps[i + 1]
        other = max(pre[i], suf[i + 2])
        best = max(best, merged + d if other >= d else merged)
    return best
